ML_DISABLED.title: Turn off machine learning
ML_DISABLED.description: Faces, smart search and duplicate detection need about 2 GB more RAM. Turn them off on NAS units with 4 GB, then also turn off Machine Learning in Administration > Settings.

HW_TRANSCODING.title: Hardware video transcoding
HW_TRANSCODING.description: Gives Immich the GPU render device (Intel Quick Sync or VA-API).
